ai/DEMO-1.title: fix(price): subtract the discount in applyDiscount instead of adding it (DEMO-1)
ai/DEMO-1.description:
DEMO-1: applyDiscount(100, 10) returned 110 instead of 90.

Change: in src/price.js, applyDiscount now computes price - price * percent / 100 instead of adding the discount. The stale "BUG" comment is removed. 1 file, +1 -2 lines.

Review verdict: pass (round 1). The review checked applyDiscount(100,10)=90, applyDiscount(80,25)=60 and applyDiscount(200,50)=100.

Tests: sh test.sh was run by the Coding bot, all 4 checks ok.

Not verified:
- applyDiscount(200, 50) = 100 was checked in the review but has no automated test.
- No tests or input checks for a percent below 0 or above 100; such values still give a price above the original or below zero.
- The Neuronet code search tool was not available, so files were read directly.
